prose.description: The thinking caste of the Hive. Princes are tall, clever, and free to act on their own, so they handle trade and dealings with outsiders for their Queen. A Prince cut off from their Hive copes better than other Hivers, because Princes are made to think for themselves.
prose.speech: Precise and careful with words, often formal, and sometimes startlingly direct. Hivers call those outside any Hive no-hives.
